parsed_action.reasoning_summary: Using the initial PC skeleton plus two interventions, I orient the ambiguous component as follows: X5 behaves as a source into the X2/X6/X13 neighborhood under X5 clamping, while X6 clamping propagated shifts to X0,X5,X13 consistent with X6 upstream of that cluster. The only edges with direct support remained the initial directed set and the unresolved pairs where intervention evidence was insufficient to fully orient, so I retain them as undirected rather than inventing directions.
